visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair and a beige top takes a selfie in front of the Colosseum under a bright blue sky. She smiles at the camera, her hair blowing slightly. Behind her, tourists walk around the base of the massive ancient stone arches. (2) The camera pans across the interior of the Colosseum, showing the layered stone arches and a ground area with construction equipment, including a red small vehicle and green protective covers. (3) A close-up pan focuses on a large white marble plaque mounted on a stone pillar, featuring inscribed Latin text. (4) The woman returns to the frame, shielding her eyes from the sun with her hand and smiling. She wears sunglasses on her head and a backpack with a visible strap. (5) A low-angle shot captures the exterior walls of the Colosseum against a sky filled with wispy white clouds. (6) The woman poses again, tilting her head and smiling radiantly at the lens. (7) A white seagull with a yellow beak stands on a weathered stone ledge. A person's finger points towards it. The Colosseum interior is blurred in the background. (8) A wide shot shows the woman in a white frilly dress and sunglasses standing by a railing overlooking the Colosseum ruins. (9) A close-up of the seagull's head as it looks around, followed by a shot of canvas pouches with black cat graphics and 'P-A-R-C' logos on tags.
